description: Privacy claims register. Each entry is a specific privacy CLAIM shown to users, mapped to the control that substantiates it, the CI test IDs that prove it, the external-evidence IDs, an approver + expiry, and a FALLBACK wording. The privacy policy page renders each claim's EFFECTIVE wording from the generated projection (apps/web/src/lib/privacy/privacy-claims.generated.json): a claim shows its substantiated wording only while it is BACKED AND CURRENT — approval unexpired, every referenced test passing in the control register, and no referenced evidence expired. Otherwise it FAILS CLOSED to the hedged fallback wording, so a claim can never appear on the page unless it is currently substantiated. Referenced external evidence may be PENDING (that keeps the issue partial) but pending does not force the fallback; an EXPIRED approval or evidence does. Generated + drift-gated by scripts/generate-privacy-claims.mjs; structure validated by scripts/check-privacy-claims.mjs.

claims.substantiatedWording: Your individual quiz answers and importance weights never leave your device — only a party match and a per-proposition agree/neutral/disagree stance, worked out on your device, are sent.
claims.fallbackWording: How your research contribution is processed is described in the sections below; see “What is collected if you opt in”.
claims.substantiatingControl: The client reduces the raw answer vector to a match + stances on device and transmits only the allowlisted, device-derived fields (apps/web/src/lib/research/transport-policy.ts projectAllowlisted, wired into survey.ts). The raw vector/weights never reach the wire; each proposition is projected to {id, stance}. Proven on the wire by the network-interception e2e.

claims.substantiatedWording: Contributions are stored only as additions to aggregate group counts; no individual research record is created or stored.
claims.fallbackWording: How research contributions are stored is described below under “Aggregate-only storage and residual risk”.
claims.substantiatingControl: The store holds only cohort-keyed aggregate counters; the committed schema (migration 0001) creates no per-person table and is aggregate-only (scripts/check-aggregate-only.mjs, ADR-0008).

claims.substantiatedWording: A contribution carries no name, email address, phone number, IP address, cookie or device identifier.
claims.fallbackWording: The identifiers a contribution does not contain are listed below under “What is never collected”.
claims.substantiatingControl: The transmitted-field allowlist admits no identifier (transport-policy.ts), the endpoints never read CF-Connecting-IP or the user agent, and no identifier or personal-data field may reach a log (scripts/check-forbidden-log-fields.mjs, PIA §6).

claims.substantiatedWording: Research contributions are sent only over an encrypted (HTTPS) connection with caching disabled, and only a fixed allowlisted set of fields is ever transmitted.
claims.fallbackWording: Research contributions are sent to our same-origin server over your browser's connection; see the sections below.
claims.substantiatingControl: Every research POST is issued through transportInit() with cache 'no-store' and credentials 'omit' over the same-origin (HTTPS) endpoint; the edge forces HTTPS + HSTS and does not cache the ingestion routes (infra/providers/cloudflare/transport-policy.json). The field allowlist is fail-closed.

claims.substantiatedWording: The research endpoints never read your IP address or user agent, and never log the request body or full address of your contribution.
claims.fallbackWording: How the research request is handled is described below under “Hosting, security and technical logs”.
claims.substantiatingControl: The ingestion Pages Functions read no IP/user-agent/forwarding header and emit no logging or error reporting of any part of the request; the static transport scan and the forbidden-log-field scan enforce this, and the edge is configured not to log request bodies (infra transport policy).

claims.substantiatedWording: Your electorate is sent as its own separate request and kept only as a running count, never paired with any result or survey answer.
claims.fallbackWording: How electorate is handled is described below under “How electorate is handled separately”.
claims.substantiatingControl: The electorate travels on the separate /api/research/geography request (its own token/nonce) and is stored only as an integer tally in geography_count that shares no key with any research counter (survey.ts, geography.ts, transport-policy.ts allowlist).

claims.substantiatedWording: Published research suppresses any group with fewer than 10 contributions.
claims.fallbackWording: How published research results are protected is described below under “Research retention and publication”.
claims.substantiatingControl: Public stats are k-suppressed at the database/view layer (HAVING SUM(n) >= 10, k = MIN_CELL) with complementary suppression against differencing; the generator reads only the allowlisted views and no Pages Function serves the counters (scripts/check-public-stat-release.mjs, stats.ts).
